about: Step 6, temp book staging/start.js (Mid's 41-boot): every piece. in v100: already home. bring: comes with its feature, as book entries and laws. cut: v100 does it another way.

CATCHUP: Mid ran fixed steps and caught up to six behind; v100's loop runs one step a frame at D98 fps with the step capped at 0.1 s
seenErr: the safety net: each kind of error logged once (with fault)
fault: the safety net: an error costs a frame, never the game; a second kind pauses and offers a restart (needs Saving for the last good save)
shed: the load governor: a slow phone sheds a level of drawing detail and climbs back when fast; v100 has the sprite and woods caches but no governor
frame: index.html loop (climate, step, tick, draw); Mid's pause, game speeds, autosave and the 15-a-second idle wait come with Menus and Saving
spdPop: the game speeds dropping under the pause button; v100 has only Fast (D116) on the Layers page
TEST_FIELD: the ?test address that opens the test field
testField: Albert's test field (Nov 3): you and one rival at war, no fog, both armies out, never saved
clip: copy to the clipboard, for the History page's copy (Menus); the test hook window.__fk at its end is v100's window.fk (index.html)
